rules.title: Residential rental application fee cap (P.L. 2025, c.405)
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent may not require an application or similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property that exceeds $50. The cap is adjusted each year for CPI increases, and violators face civil penalties and must refund the amount wrongfully charged.
rules.key_value: $50 maximum application fee, adjusted annually by CPI (NY-Northern NJ-Long Island) when the change is greater than zero

coverage_conditions.summary: Residential rental properties other than dwelling units in one- or two-family dwellings; real estate licensees acting as agents are not bound unless they are the landlord.
coverage_conditions.owner_conditions: Does not apply to a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission unless the licensee is the landlord of the property.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Dwelling units in a one-family or two-family dwelling offered for rent are exempt.

rules.exemptions: A dwelling unit located in a one-family or two-family dwelling that is offered for rent; a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission, unless the licensee is the landlord of the residential rental property.
rules.quoted_span:
A landlord, or
agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply
to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which
exceeds $50.
